 Mr.D.C.Chahande, Counsel for Respondent No.3.
 Coram : Neeraj P. Dhote, J.
Date : 30/03/2026
1.
This is the Appeal by the Claimant for enhanced compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act.
There is cross- objection/Appeal by the vehicle owner against the dismissal of his cross-objection by the learned Tribunal.
The learned Advocate for the Insurance Company submits that, the counter claim was not maintainable and the learned Tribunal has rightly held so.
He submits that, the counter Appeal will not be maintainable.
2. The learned Advocate for the vehicle owner seeks accommodation to make the submissions on the point of maintainability of his counter claim.
JUDGE Signed by: Kavita P Kavita Tayade Designation: PS To Honourable Judge Date: 30/03/2026 18:48:30
